label: China AI regulation · Cumulative CAC generative AI filings (mid-2027)
prompt: How many generative AI services will have completed CAC filing (cumulative, excluding app/feature registrations) as of the CAC announcement covering 30 June 2027?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the cumulative filed-services count in the first CAC announcement whose cut-off is on or after 30 June 2027. Baseline: 1,112 as of 31 August 2026.

diagnostics.label: Batch cadence
diagnostics.note: Batches every ~2 months; ~124 services in the Jul–Aug 2026 batch.

diagnostics.label: Coverage drift
diagnostics.note: On-device filings (first list July 2026) may be counted separately.
